narrative: Placement coordinator emails a shortlist notice with an urgent deadline.

message.body: Urgent: You have been shortlisted for the TechCorp internship. You must fill out the attached registration form within 20 minutes or your nomination will be cancelled.

evidence.label: Official Placement Portal Notice
evidence.value: No shortlist notice published on college.edu.in portal.

consequence_text.safe: Verifying on the official placement portal revealed no such shortlist. You avoided installing malicious executable software.
consequence_text.unsafe: Opening the executable attachment would have installed malware on your system (simulated).

teaching_point: Urgent claims from authority figures should increase your verification effort rather than rushing your decision.
